Part 1 必考 地点 PLACE

The area you live in

你居住的地区

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Do you like the area that you live in?

Yeah, I like it, honestly. I live in Xin'an Street, and there's a place called Qianhai nearby where you can see the sea and lots of parks. The people are friendly as well, so it's quite comfortable to live in.

喜欢，因为前海离得近、能看海，还有好多公园，周围人也友善。

Q2Where do you like to go in that area?

I often go to Qianhai, actually. There are plenty of parks there, and you can see the sea, which is great for a walk after work. Sometimes I just sit by the water and relax for a while.

常去前海，公园多又能看海，下班后去散散步、坐坐很放松。

Q3Do you know any famous people in your area?

Not really, I don't think so. The people in my neighborhood are mostly ordinary folks, like office workers and students, so nobody famous as far as I know. But everyone seems quite nice and friendly, I guess.

没听说有名人，邻居都是普通上班族和学生，不过人都挺和善的。

Q4What are some changes in the area recently?

Well, my own neighborhood hasn't really changed that much, to be honest. But a brand new residential community has been built nearby recently, and I've noticed a lot of new families moving in, which makes the place feel livelier.

自己小区变化不大，倒是周边新建了一个住宅小区，搬来很多新家庭。

Q5Do you know any of your neighbors?

Yeah, I know quite a few of them, like the family living next door. We don't really chat much, though, probably just a quick hello now and then, but they seem really friendly and easy to get along with.

认识几个邻居，但很少深聊，顶多打个招呼，人都挺和善好相处。

Q6Are the people in your neighborhood nice and friendly?

To be honest, yes, they are. Most of them are friendly, even though we don't really talk to each other that often. When we meet in the elevator or downstairs, they always greet you with a smile, which I appreciate.

都挺友善的，虽然不常聊天，但在电梯或楼下碰到都会微笑打招呼。

Q7Do you live in a noisy or a quiet area?

It's quiet, I'd say. My apartment is in a residential community, so there's not much traffic noise at night. Occasionally you hear construction from the new community nearby, but it's not too bad, and I sleep well.

挺安静的，小区夜里没什么车流噪音，偶尔能听到附近新建小区的施工声。
